name: Overchannel
desc: When you cast a Wizard spell of levels 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell. The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, you take 2d12 necrotic damage per level of the spell immediately after casting it. Each time you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, the necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.
